description: Chambre Télécom is a dataset listed in Opendata de Grand Paris Sud open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Numérique @ Grand Paris Sud. Géolocalisation des chambres télécoms appartenant à la communauté d'agglomération de Grand Paris Sud. Ces données sont mises à disposition des opérateurs dans le cadre des déploiements des réseau de communication électronique. Article L.33-7 du code des postes et des communications électroniques. L'utilisation de ces infrastructures est soumise à conventionnement avec l'entité Grand Paris Sud. Coverage: Grand Paris Sud (Essonne and Seine-et-Marne). The portal files it under Télecommunications. Its keywords are L1425-1, chambre, Télécommunication, infrastructure, connaissance des réseaux, communication électronique. The portal shows 9,496 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-grandparissud-fr-portal.
